nota: «Turn off your phone»: un video nuevo desde el carrusel del mismo nombre. Cada frase empieza en su escena; bloques de hasta 11 s que empiezan en un cambio de escena.

bloques.como: Calm, almost a whisper, like a dare. Stop right on «phone»: the screen goes black.
A real question. Lift on «still selling». The sign flips to CLOSED (0:03,9).
Energy up, friendly, like starting a game.

bloques.texto: One: is your contact form full of bots?
bloques.ve: Is your contact form full of bots?
bloques.como: Light, a little amused. «One» on the beat.

bloques.texto: Two: to change a price, do you wait on someone?
bloques.ve: To change a price, do you wait on someone?
bloques.como: A bit tired on «wait on someone», like you've been there.
Lower and slower. Leave it hanging: the music drops out.

bloques.texto: PHP2Shell. Seven in ten sites run PHP. Is yours patched?
bloques.ve: PHP2Shell. Is yours patched? 7 in 10 websites run PHP.

bloques.texto: Four: when you don't answer, do sales stop?
bloques.ve: When you don't answer, do sales stop?
bloques.como: Close, a bit concerned. The two messages pop out of the phone.

bloques.texto: Five costs less than you think…
bloques.como: Playful secret, smiling. The music drops out again.

bloques.texto: Want ads, but don't know where to start? Test with five dollars a day.
bloques.ve: Want to run ads, but don't know where to start? $5 a day.
bloques.como: Energy back on the beat. «Five dollars a day» when the cursor taps «Publish ad» (0:30,4).

bloques.texto: Six: how many people visited your site this week?
bloques.ve: How many people visited your site this week?
bloques.como: A real question, curious. Pause after «six».

bloques.texto: Every yes has a fix. Bot-proof forms. Prices you change. No PHP, daily backups. Juditos that answer. Guided ads. Your visits, in your portal.
bloques.ve: Every yes has a fix. Six fixes, one by one.
bloques.como: Confident and warm. Say each fix when its card comes in: forms 0:37,7; prices 0:38,6; PHP 0:39,7; Juditos 0:41,6; ads 0:43,2; visits 0:44,0.

bloques.texto: All of this is fixed one chat away. Said yes to any? Message us on WhatsApp.
bloques.ve: All of this is fixed one chat away. Said yes to any? Message us.
bloques.como: Warm, the most human line. Pause before «Said yes to any?» (0:49,8).
